title: Window layout
idea: Window layout: A workspace map previews pane arrangements before applying
audience: People who need to arrange workspace within a desktop surface.
avoidWhen: There is one simple linear flow
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic workspace layout through its arrange workspace priority and explicit commitment contract: Persist only after a recoverable layout change
navigation: Window layout keeps the current arrange workspace context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A workspace map previews pane arrangements before applying
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to arrange workspace; users work across multiple panes
composition.priority: Persist only after a recoverable layout change

imagery.role: Support the actual arrange workspace context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Enforce pane minimums and a restore layout option
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the window layout structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no arrange workspace content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Persist only after a recoverable layout change
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized arrange workspace content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Persist only after a recoverable layout change
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active arrange workspace context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
